record.question: Recipient serum is mixed with donor's red cells in which type of cross matching:
record.explanation: Official final key: A — Major crossmatching. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 7, printed Q60. Source limitation: The source mixes the major/minor direction labels with an assay-method label; major and indirect antiglobulin are not mutually exclusive alternatives. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
